text: China's Q3 GDP grew 4.5% YoY versus 4.3% in Q2. September industrial output rose 5.5%, retail sales 1.1%, and the trade surplus reached $133.5B. Nine-month fixed asset investment fell 7.2%, property investment fell 20.6%, and consumer inflation remained below 1%.

meta.note: Export and domestic-sector indicators occupy opposing positions within the same aggregate growth measure.
